2609.01507.title: LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision
2609.01507.paper_summary: Compressed context is usually carried as human-readable text or as rendered images that must be decoded, even when its consumer is a language model. We introduce LatentPress, which writes conversational histories and long documents into a third representation: continuous memory tokens that a frozen decoder reads directly through its input-embedding interface, with no text reconstruction at inference. A small reader-matched writer compresses $4$-$16\times$ while training only an adapter (4.2M-26.2M parameters, $\sim\!0.1\%$ of the decoder). On LongMemEval, LatentPress reaches $0.504$ accuracy at $7.70\times$ compression versus $0.490$ for uncompressed evidence, outperforming text summaries (0.184) and OCR-based compression (0.426 to 0.312). On LongBench-QA, in-domain writers match or exceed raw-context reading at $4$-$8\times$ compression, while $16\times$ trails raw. Writing takes 43ms per conversation, roughly an order of magnitude faster than text summarization or OCR reconstruction, and reading is $5$-$9\times$ faster than raw context or cached OCR. We validate the interface under two transfer settings, zero-shot from UltraChat to LongMemEval memory QA and from LongMemEval-derived QA to unseen LongBench document domains, establishing direct soft tokens as a practical machine-facing context interface beyond text and vision. The implementation of the experiments could be found at: https://github.com/xuyd16ai/context_softtoken_compress .
2609.01507.paper_summary_zh: 壓縮的上下文通常以人類可讀的文本或必須解碼的渲染圖像形式存在，即使其消費者是語言模型。我們介紹了LatentPress，它將對話歷史和長文檔寫入第三種表示：持續的記憶標記，這些標記由凍結的解碼器通過其輸入嵌入接口直接讀取，而無需在推理過程中進行文本重建。一個小型的讀者匹配寫入器在僅訓練適配器的情況下壓縮了$4$-$16\times$（4.2M-26.2M參數，$\sim\!0.1\%$的解碼器）。在LongMemEval上，LatentPress在$7.70\times$壓縮下達到$0.504$的準確率，而未壓縮證據的準確率為$0.490$，超越了文本摘要（0.184）和基於OCR的壓縮（0.426到0.312）。在LongBench-QA上，領域內的寫入器在$4$-$8\times$壓縮下與原始上下文閱讀相匹配或超越，而$16\times$則落後於原始上下文。寫作每次對話需時43毫秒，這大約比文本摘要或OCR重建快一個量級，閱讀速度比原始上下文或緩存的OCR快$5$-$9\times$。我們在兩個轉移設置下驗證了該接口，從UltraChat到LongMemEval記憶QA的零樣本轉移，以及從LongMemEval衍生的QA到未見的LongBench文檔領域，確立了直接的軟標記作為超越文本和視覺的實用機器面向上下文接口。實驗的實施可以在以下網址找到：https://github.com/xuyd16ai/context_softtoken_compress 。
